content.title: Anaemia screen
content.body: Your lab report shows haemoglobin of 9.2 g/dL, which is low; a normal range sits above 12. This is a screening signal and not a diagnosis. Start taking 325 mg of ferrous sulphate twice daily and see a doctor within 7 days if you still feel tired.
recommendations: Book a doctor visit within 7 days.
